name: states
title: Loading, empty and error states
description: The three non-happy states of async data, ready to reuse: ui/loading-state (skeleton rows, aria-busy, shimmer only without reduced motion), ui/empty-state (what is missing and what to do, optional action link) and comp/order-list, which renders a promise with {#await}: loading → skeleton, error → kit <ErrorState> with Retry, empty → empty state, data → the list. views/orders.brain feeds it from an api() resource.
notes: Pass a promise (a resource) and a retry function to the list; every state is covered by the {#await} block. Link /orders from the nav.
